name: bicep-visualizer
languageServer: Unmodified bicepLanguageServer from the same release
adaptations: VS Code postMessage replaced by capability-protected loopback HTTP and SSE
Source and Problems shown in a canvas details pane; source can also open in VS Code
Save As uses a canvas dialog with a destination folder and exclusive PNG creation
Live updates follow saved files; unsaved editor buffers are not accessible
Workspace entrypoint selection persists by canonical workspace path
Graph interactions and export controls remain the original upstream implementation
Export toolbar wraps in narrow canvas panels without changing its controls
